intro: Asimi helps you understand local projects, plan changes and review them before they run.
privacy: Workspaces and history stay on this device. Connected AI receives only the content you choose to send.
keyStored: An encrypted key is stored. Leave this blank to use it.
keyPrivacy: Windows encrypts your key for your account.
testNote: The test sends a short text prompt to DeepSeek and may incur a small API charge.
noKey: No API key is stored for this preset.
readyOffline: You’re in offline mode. Browse projects, check your environment and view local history. You can connect a model anytime in AI Providers.
project: Choose a local project to get started.
timeoutNote: Leave blank to use the app’s request limits. Enter 1–120 seconds to set a shorter deadline.
testScope: This connection test checks text responses. Other capabilities are listed from the preset.
configuredTestScope: This connection test checks text responses. Other capabilities are listed from the model configuration.
offline: A default model is not configured.
errorTimeout: The provider did not answer in time. Check your connection, then retry.
errorKey: DeepSeek rejected the API key. Check that the key is active and enter it again.
errorCredential: Windows could not access the stored key. Enter your API key again.
errorNetwork: Asimi could not reach DeepSeek over a secure connection. Check your network, then retry.
errorRate: DeepSeek limited the request. Check your quota or wait a moment before retrying.
errorBalance: DeepSeek reported insufficient balance. Check your account balance, then retry.
errorModel: DeepSeek did not accept the recommended model. Check model access on your DeepSeek account.
errorUnavailable: DeepSeek could not complete the test. Retry when the service is available.
errorChanged: The provider settings changed during the test. Review the current settings and retry.
errorIncomplete: DeepSeek returned an incomplete response. Retry the connection test.
errorOutcome: The connection dropped before the test result arrived. Check your network and retry.
